## What you will find here

- **Prices:** PTF and SMF by hour, day and month.
- **Generation mix:** output by source, with year on year comparisons.
- **Demand:** hourly consumption and its seasonal pattern.

All figures come from the EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu. See the [methodology](../../methodology.qmd) for definitions and processing steps.
